title: 第一卷 第9章 追兵已至第一卷 第10章 要借我的头你还不够格
content_zh:
林辰眼底杀意顿时汹涌起来。
兖州王！
林辰一定会去兖州杀了他！
芈璃没有管林辰的情绪，继续毫无波动的开口，“林婉儿虽不愿，但不得不为仅剩的几个族人考虑，她别无选择！”
“她答应嫁入王府，条件是要先守灵一个月，同时，将族人送往百战废土。”
闻言，林辰双手用力捏紧拳头！
百战废土，是一片被打乱的山河，不属于任何国度，即便是大魏国，也难以将触角渗透那里。
林婉儿选择百战废土，显然是经过了深思熟虑的。
但，百战废土很乱，三教九流齐聚，去那里依旧有着凶险！
当然，林辰也明白，这已经是林婉儿这个柔弱女子，尽最大努力换来的！
她能做的只有这些了。
林婉儿就是这样。
她不是林家族人，是林辰母亲从雪地里捡回来的孤儿，她经历过流离失所、饥寒交迫，在死亡的绝望中，是林家给了她家的温暖。
她感激所有对她好的人，她比任何人都珍视这个家！
尤其是林辰。
林婉儿与林辰自小一起长大，她将林辰视作比自己生命更重要的存在。
为了林辰，她可以做任何事！
那柔软双肩，可以为了林辰扛下所有，即便，那将是难以忍受的痛苦与屈辱！
“你现在的位置并不安全，尽快决定下来该往哪走，该做什么”
，芈璃依旧毫无波动的开口。

通过传音符，她已经知道林辰具体的方位。
林辰深吸一口气，他的确很担心林婉儿现在的处境，但也明白林婉儿所做的一切，就是为了族人可以活下去。
他唯一的选择，就是前往百战废土，护住族人，然后杀入兖州王府，手刃兖州王，解救林婉儿。
而留给他的时间，只有一个月！
这对于一个此刻还只是霸罡境的人来说，好似天方夜谭。
“我明白的”
，林辰松开紧握的拳头，现在的他，不能乱，走错一步都可能万劫不复！
他现在背负着所有人的性命，他不能错！
“伤势恢复一些之后，我会即刻赶往百战废土，我必须先救下族人，解决后顾之忧，而且，那地方也适合现在的我”
，林辰沉声道。
“嗯”
，芈璃的声音传来，她不会干扰林辰做决定，“需要我做什么？”
“你去兖州”
，林辰道。
“好”
，芈璃道。
她知道林辰是让她去守着林婉儿，随时报告林婉儿的情况。
现在芈璃能力范围内的事情，也只有这个了。
“拜托你了”
content_en:
Killing intent suddenly surged in Lin Chen's eyes.
King of Yanzhou!
Lin Chen will definitely go to Yanzhou to kill him!
Mi Li ignored Lin Chen's emotions and continued to speak without any fluctuation, "Although Lin Wan'er doesn't want to, she has to consider the few remaining clan members. She has no choice!"
"She agreed to marry into the prince's palace on the condition that she would keep vigil for a month and at the same time send her clan members to the Wasteland of Hundred Wars."
Hearing this, Lin Chen clenched his fists with both hands!
The Wasteland of Hundred Wars is a mess of mountains and rivers that have been disrupted and does not belong to any country. Even the Great Wei Kingdom has difficulty penetrating its tentacles there.
Lin Wan'er's choice of the Wasteland was obviously a matter of careful consideration.
However, the Wasteland of Hundred Wars is very chaotic, with three religions and nine streams gathering together, it is still dangerous to go there!
Of course, Lin Chen also understood that this was earned by Lin Wan'er, a weak woman, who had tried her best!
It was all she could do.
That's what Lin Wan'er is like.
She was not a member of the Lin family, but an orphan picked up from the snow by Lin Chen's mother. She had experienced displacement, hunger and cold, and in the despair of death, it was the Lin family who gave her the warmth of home.
She is grateful to all the people who are kind to her, and she values ​​this family more than anyone else!
Especially Lin Chen.
Lin Wan'er and Lin Chen grew up together since childhood, and she regards Lin Chen as a being more important than her own life.
For Lin Chen, she can do anything!
Those soft shoulders can carry everything for Lin Chen, even if it will be unbearable pain and humiliation!
"Your current location is not safe. Decide where to go and what to do as soon as possible."
, Mi Li still spoke without any fluctuation.
Through the transmission notes, she already knew Lin Chen's specific location.
Lin Chen took a deep breath. He was indeed worried about Lin Wan'er's current situation, but he also understood that everything Lin Wan'er did was for the sake of the tribe's survival.
His only choice was to go to the Wasteland of Hundreds of Wars to protect his people, then rush into the Yanzhou Prince's Mansion, kill the Yanzhou Prince with his own hands, and rescue Lin Wan'er.
And the time left for him is only one month!
For a person who is still in the Ba Gang Realm at this moment, this seems like a fantasy.
"I understand"
, Lin Chen loosened his clenched fists. He couldn't be careless now. If he made a wrong step, he might be in catastrophe!
He is now carrying everyone's lives, he can't be wrong!
"After I recover from my injuries, I will immediately rush to the Wasteland of Hundreds of Wars. I must first save my people and solve my worries. Moreover, that place is suitable for me now."
, Lin Chen said in a deep voice.
"Hmm"
, Mi Li's voice came. She would not interfere with Lin Chen's decision-making, "What do you need me to do?"
"You go to Yanzhou"
, Lin Chen said.
"good"
, Mi Li said.
She knew that Lin Chen asked her to guard Lin Waner and report Lin Waner's situation at any time.
Now this is the only thing Mi Li can do.
"Please"
